parsed.explanation: Thin dossier, so I extrapolated from structural signals. No trans-specific criminal offence or sexuality-law enforcement is documented, and the 2015 marriage definition expressly names gender identity, a climate signal of trans-inclusive legislation. Constitutional anti-discrimination covers sexual orientation only, and no incidents or social-acceptance evidence appear in the record, so the silence is not treated as a positive. Document markers, screening, facilities and healthcare are undocumented; these are open questions, weighted lightly per rule 13, but they keep the score below the reduced-risk tier's upper range. The small, visible community adds uncertainty about social reception. Rated in the reduced-risk band.
